t: In India, the insurance sector is regulated by_______.
e: Correct answer: IRDAI / ????????? (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Rate can be defined as:-
o: The price per unit of insurance against each exposure unit
Average premium charged to the insured's in the sa
Highest amount of premium that can be charged / ??
Lowest amount of premium that needs to be charged
e: Correct answer: The price per unit of insurance against each exposure unit (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Give an example of Express Warranties in case of Marine insurance.
o: The ship under voyage should be seaworthy at the c
The venture of voyage should be a legal one
The ship should not deviate from its normal course
Voyage on sail should take lawful goods and commod
Time of sailing of the ship should be strictly followed
e: Correct answer: Time of sailing of the ship should be strictly followed (from the IC45 question bank).

t: _____________ is an increase in the premium if there is a claim in the previous year.
e: Correct answer: Malus (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Identify the scenario where a proposal needs to be declined.
o: Proposal falls within lowest risk boundaries
Proposal falls within normal risk boundaries
Proposal falls outside normal risk boundaries but
Proposal falls outside acceptable risk boundaries
Proposal is from a respected member of the society
e: Correct answer: Proposal falls outside acceptable risk boundaries (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Determining the requirements for compiling and analysing data on sums insured is the responsibility of ________.
e: Correct answer: Actuary (from the IC45 question bank).

t: What does a percentage deductible of 10% mean?
o: Insurer pays 10% of premium received in case of cl
Insurer pays 90% of premium received in case of cl
Premium is hiked by 10% in case of claim
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Insurer pays 90% of loss amount (from the IC45 question bank).

t: __________ includes non-life products that are specially designed to suit the specific needs of  clients.
e: Correct answer: Customised product (from the IC45 question bank).

t: A combined ratio over 100% indicates ________.
e: Correct answer: Underwriting loss (from the IC45 question bank).

t: What is maximum limit for the amount under dispute that can be entertained by the Ombudsman?
e: Correct answer: Rs 20 lakhs (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following factors is not required to obtain Target Loss Ratio in case of Loss Ratio method?
o: Ratio for non-premium related expenses to losses
e: Correct answer: Ratio for non-premium related expenses to losses (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Within the Class rated Products, which of the following will be considered a package policy?

I. Retail health insurance
II. Burglary insurance
III. Office insurance
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Risk is evaluated on the basis of ________.

I. Variability
II. Contingency
III. Probability
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: ________ is a property insurance cover in which the policy holder arranges cover for an amount below the full value of items insured and for this, the insurer agrees not to penalise him for under insurance.
e: Correct answer: First loss policy (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
The contents of general insurance policy shall include:-

I. Non-competing clause
II. Sum insured and premium details
III. Non-disclosure clause
e: Correct answer: II only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following information is most likely to be sought in a proposal form?

I. Information on proposers personal life
II. Information not material to the risk
III. Previous insurance history
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following correctly refers to CRM?
e: Correct answer: Customer relationship management (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Identify the scenario where a policy can be issued on a standard basis.
o: Proposal falls within lowest risk boundaries
Proposal falls within normal risk boundaries
Proposal falls outside normal risk boundaries but
Proposal falls outside acceptable risk boundaries
Proposal is from a respected member of the society
e: Correct answer: Proposal falls within lowest risk boundaries (from the IC45 question bank).

t: In which case will the insurer need prior approval only in case the rate change is substantial  e.g. 10% - 25%?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Flex rating laws (from the IC45 question bank).

t: __________________ an estimated amount of money the insurance company expects to pay in the future for losses that have already occurred and been reported, but are not yet settled.
e: Correct answer: Loss Reserve (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised.

Risk: Jewellers, dealers in precious stones
e: Correct answer: Miscellaneous (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
The Compliance Officer shall be responsible for:-

I. Underwriting
II. Distribution and Marketing
III. File a complete list of all products falling under categories as defined in the 'F&U' guidelines
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Customer needs can be identified by monitoring _____________.
e: Correct answer: Underwriters' report (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
None of the following are contained in a proposal form EXCEPT:-

I. Bank Guarantee
II. Surety bond
III. Details of the subject matter
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following is true with regards to cover note issued by the insurer?

I. Usually the cover note is issued for a temporary period of 30 days
II. For the insured, it is the evidence of risk covered
III. The cover note is followed by the issue of a fully worded policy document once the insurer has complete information related to the risk
e: Correct answer: I and II and III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
International insurance coverage is most likely to be needed in case of:-

I. Fire insurance
II. Property insurance
III. Marine hull insurance
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Market regulation encompasses a number of different aspects of insurers' activities INCLUDING:-

I. Claims adjustments
II. Recruitment
III. Training
e: Correct answer: I only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: In a city loss experience of 1000 bikes each valued at Rs. 75,000 by theft shows that over a period of say 10 years, on average 2 bikes are stolen.  How much will be the pure premium?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Rs. 150 (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Insurance documentation includes:-

I. Agents code of conduct
II. Insurers vision statement
III. Policy Document, Conditions and Warranties
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Identify the factor(s) that are considered while calculating premium rate using experience rating.

I. Rate calculated using class rating
II. Past loss experience
III. New exposure characteristics
e: Correct answer: I and II and III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Underwriting is the process by which an insurer determines:-

I. Whether or not to accept a risk
II. Terms and conditions for acceptance
III. Level of premium to be charged
e: Correct answer: I and II and III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following factors need to be considered while making underwriting decisions?

I. Staff capability
II. Marketing spend
III. Intermediaries and commissions offered
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following category of risks can be the subject matter of general insurance?

I. Life
II. Stock market volatility
III. Risks of householders, shopkeepers etc.
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Suggest methods for monitoring compliance with respect to underwriting policies.
o: Assessments of brokers procedures and systems
e: Correct answer: Assessments of brokers procedures and systems (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Suggest steps to plan for underwriting profitability.
o: Get the underwriting philosophy duly vetted by top management and actuary  of the company
Charge heavy premiums for catastrophe insurance
e: Correct answer: Get the underwriting philosophy duly vetted by top management and actuary  of the company (from the IC45 question bank).

t: A city loss experience of 1000 bikes each valued at Rs. 75,000 by theft shows that over a period of say 10 years, on average 2 bikes are stolen.  How much will be the pure premium?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 150 / ??. 150 (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The permitted limit of foreign direct investment in an Indian insurance company is currently:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Raised from 49% to 74% by the Insurance (Amendment) Act 2021; intermediaries may have 100%.

t:
Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised.

Risk: Camphor boiling works
e: Correct answer: Fire (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The ________ method is based on the assumption that claims move from the unreported to the reported and from unpaid to paid in a pattern which is sufficiently uniform so that past experience can be used to predict future development.
e: Correct answer: Loss Development / ???? ???? (from the IC45 question bank).

t: In order to ensure that all underwriting is done in compliance with the 'F&U' guidelines, it is essential to constitute a __________.
e: Correct answer: Technical Audit Department (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following areas in insurance sector should benefit from the deployment of IT systems across the enterprise?

I. Claims administration
II. Client management - CRM
III. Brokerage & commissions
e: Correct answer: I and II and III (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following can be termed as a business interruption risk?
o: Profits lost because production was stopped as a result of an accident
Disability as a result of an accident / ???????? ?
e: Correct answer: Profits lost because production was stopped as a result of an accident (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The purpose of underwriting audit is __________.
o: To give feedback to the underwriter and to the management
e: Correct answer: To give feedback to the underwriter and to the management (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Insurance is a form of:-
e: Correct answer: Risk Transfer (from the IC45 question bank).

t: _________ is a clause contained in an insurance policy which describes the condition or type of loss that is not covered by the policy.
e: Correct answer: Exclusion (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Under the IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations 2024, the free-look period for a policy with a term of one year or more is:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). 30 days from receipt of the policy document, irrespective of the sales channel.

t:
Which among the following is exclusion under marine insurance for the proposal mentioned below? Proposal: Oil in second hand drums

I: Damage due to water
II: Loss as a result of sunken cargo
III: Leakage and contamination
e: Correct answer: III only / ???? III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised.

Risk: Bulk cargo on terms wider than I.C.C.
e: Correct answer: Marine (from the IC45 question bank).

t: An insurer shall dispose of a claim within 30 days of receipt of the survey report.
e: Correct answer: 30 (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Insurance documentation includes:

I. Agents code of conduct
II. Insurers vision statement
III. Proposal form
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).
